results.title: H.D.I.D.T.B.A.L.
results.overview: A woman has an existential crisis when she's asked out by a woman for the first time. What should she wear that shows her true self?

results.title: Jacky
results.overview: Pelle is haunted by horror star Jacky as she jumps out of the TV screen. The slasher short "Jacky" is composed of recently unearthed VHS-tapes.

results.title: The Hatch
results.overview: A young couple move into their new home and when they go into the loft and bring down an old teddy bear they unwillingly invite a malevolent demon into their home.

results.title: Princess of the Murder
results.overview: Princess of the Murder is a campy, self-aware horror comedy that blends outrageous humor with over-the-top scares. It’s a story about cruelty, transformation, and the monstrous side of revenge—all wrapped in a delightfully ridiculous Halloween package. Balancing dark themes with absurd fun, the film delivers both chills and laughs, celebrating the spirit of B-movie horror while offering a tragic yet twistedly empowering tale.

results.title: Creation
results.overview: The Hungarian word "alkotás" (artwork) has a dual meaning – it can refer both to the process of creation and to the finished artwork. The film tells the story of how a canvas comes alive, how playful, abstract forms are created, each one carrying its own human narrative.

results.title: A Statement
results.overview: At a beachside resort in Florida in 1980, twenty experts gather for a weekend conference on a global issue that is starting to gain traction: the effects of Co2 emissions on the climate. The group of scientists, activists, and policymakers have one simple mandate from Congress — write a statement about what to do. Easier said than done.

results.title: From the Ashes
results.overview: Two old buddies reunite to scatter the ashes of their friend and brother. Unbeknownst to them, they are soon to be visited by their late companion from beyond the grave.

results.title: Marge
results.overview: After learning she’s pregnant, Sadie reflects back on the night she learned her mother was a serial killer. But now becoming a mother herself, Sadie suddenly finds herself understanding Marge in a way she never has before.

results.title: Two Minutes, One Cup
results.overview: After a sudden break-up, the hungry Maggie falls in love sooner than she expects...

results.title: Stone Memory
results.overview: Urbanization and shifting regimes erased WWII mass graves from Serbian city centers. Brutalist architect Bogdan Bogdanović designed a monumental memorial outside Čačak, both a tribute to the victims and a testament to his architectural vision.  Now largely neglected and overgrown, the memorial is brought to life through the voices of locals, archival materials, and reenactments. The film explores how memory, history, and architecture intersect, gradually revealing the human stories behind the monument’s silence.

results.title: What Can't Be Mentioned
results.overview: 14 years after Dan Sallitt’s The Unspeakable Act (2012), we catch up with Jackie, now a married therapist-in-training who attempts to resolve issues of sexual dysfunction with her husband before deciding to visit her brother and newly pregnant sister-in-law.

results.title: While the Green Grass Grows: A Diary in Seven Parts
results.original_title: While the Green Grass Grows: A Diary in Seven Parts
results.overview: A chronicle of the wonders found in everyday life and events. Tragic and comic, philosophical and poetic, Mettler’s diary combines personal conversations, family history, memories, and love. The film gracefully explores our shared destiny and elevates the diary to the level of visionary cinema. Its meditative approach and investigative gaze create a space to capture the fragility of relationships, where reflections on the human condition and the environment merge in a stream of consciousness. Mettler travels between Switzerland and Canada, visits the mountains of New Mexico, and teaches at a film school in Cuba. He is always accompanied by the camera, “a machine that carries me through time.”

results.title: La Nit del Foc
results.overview: It's all chaotic. Children are shouting, playing, making a mess, eating whatever they want, and making the world their own. Not an adult voice is heard disturbing the madness. It's San Juan, the night of fire was yesterday, but the party continues... What happened? Where are the parents? With a few shots and four drawings, the film evokes the most perverse and funniest childhood fantasies.

results.title: Go for Broke 2
results.overview: After their children are brutalised, Sheila and her brother Su Cheng uncover a sinister conspiracy through perilous investigations. Battling for justice, they expose the corrupt network while finding redemption in their vengeful quest.

results.title: Subscriber
results.overview: An obnoxious real estate YouTuber takes his crew to a dilapidated farmhouse in Ohio, one of his recent purchases. Once they enter the remote house, they learn there is an entity not of this earth that refuses to let them leave…

results.title: La visite de la vieille dame
results.original_title: La visite de la vieille dame
results.overview: Adaptation for TV of the play by Friedrich Durrenmatt. A very rich old lady arrives in her nearly bankrupt native village. She is ready to come to the rescue but only if her old lover who had once abandoned her pregnant is killed.

results.title: The Door
results.overview: A young man gets another chance to pursue his dying wish: perfection.

results.title: Northbound
results.overview: What happens when a professional surfer reaches their breaking point? After battling chronic fatigue and burnout, eight-time UK surf champion Lucy Campbell reflects on a decade of competitive surfing and the exhilarating risk of chasing waves in the freezing mizzle and golden hours of the Scottish Highlands.
